      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/ headers and implementations to eliminate process-global secondary index instances (g_txindex, g_txospenderindex, etc.) and transition ownership to NodeContext.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Moves index ownership out of process-wide static globals and into NodeContext, improving encapsulation and easing testing with multiple node instances. While this is primarily an architectural refactor rather than a data integrity or performance improvement, eliminating global index state provides clear architectural value."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in net_processing are mechanical callsite adaptations passing index callbacks via PeerManager::Options.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter P2P network behavior or message processing; the modifications are purely mechanical caller adaptations."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to RPC and REST handlers merely retrieve indexes from NodeContext rather than global pointers.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC adjustments are mechanical plumbing following the ownership shift in NodeContext without intentionally changing RPC semantics."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/util/setup_common.cpp and index tests to adapt test harness context setup.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to test files are mechanical follow-ups to index ownership refactoring rather than test framework improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp to manage index lifecycle via NodeContext.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Init changes follow directly from index ownership changes rather than changes to core utilities or startup infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only optional secondary indexes under src/index/, not consensus, UTXO, or block storage validation code.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Optional secondary indexes belong to the indexes category; no validation logic or mandatory databases are modified despite the maintainer label."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
